when the validation set is larger than the training set
when one class contains significantly more records than another

The same algorithm is best whenever accuracy is measured.
when the validation set is larger than the training set
when one class contains significantly more records than another

questions.question: A dataset has 9,000 healthy and 1,000 diseased patients. A model predicts every patient as healthy. What accuracy can it achieve?
questions.question_ar: تضم البيانات 9000 سليم و1000 مريض. يتنبأ النموذج بأن الجميع سليمون. ما الدقة التي قد يحققها؟

questions.question: What does high accuracy not always indicate?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي لا تشير إليه الدقة العالية دائماً؟
questions.explanation: High accuracy does not always mean that a classification model is good.

questions.question: What happens in overfitting?
options: the model uses validation data as a target variable
the model is too simple to learn important patterns
the model learns the training data too closely
the model predicts every record as the majority class
options_en: the model uses validation data as a target variable
the model is too simple to learn important patterns
the model learns the training data too closely
the model predicts every record as the majority class
options_ar: يستخدم النموذج بيانات التحقق متغيراً مستهدفاً
يكون النموذج بسيطاً جداً لتعلم الأنماط المهمة
يتعلم النموذج بيانات التدريب بصورة مفرطة
يتنبأ النموذج بكل سجل على أنه الفئة الأكبر
questions.explanation: Overfitting occurs when the model learns the training data too closely.
questions.explanation_ar: يتعلم النموذج بيانات التدريب بصورة مفرطة

questions.question: What may the model have learned instead of general patterns?
questions.question_ar: ماذا قد يكون النموذج قد تعلم بدلاً من الأنماط العامة؟
questions.explanation: The algorithm examines the training data and learns patterns.

questions.question: Which data condition can cause overfitting?
questions.question_ar: أي حالة في البيانات يمكن أن تسبب فرط التكيّف؟

questions.question: How is an underfitting model described?
options: when the model learns the training data too closely
too simple to learn the important patterns in the data
when a tree contains unnecessary branches only
the model predicts every record as the majority class
options_en: when the model learns the training data too closely
too simple to learn the important patterns in the data
when a tree contains unnecessary branches only
the model predicts every record as the majority class
options_ar: عندما يتعلم النموذج بيانات التدريب بصورة مفرطة
بسيط جداً ليتعلم الأنماط المهمة في البيانات
عندما تحتوي الشجرة على فروع غير ضرورية فقط
يتنبأ النموذج بكل سجل على أنه الفئة الأكبر
questions.explanation: Underfitting occurs when the model is too simple to learn the important patterns in the data.

questions.question: Training accuracy is 65 percent and testing accuracy is 63 percent, and both are poor. What problem is described?
questions.question_ar: دقة التدريب 65 بالمئة ودقة الاختبار 63 بالمئة وكلتاهما ضعيفة. ما المشكلة الموصوفة؟
questions.explanation: Underfitting occurs when the model is too simple to learn the important patterns in the data.

questions.question: What can too many irrelevant features increase?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي قد تسببه كثرة الخصائص غير الملائمة؟

questions.question: Which approach can handle missing data?
questions.question_ar: أي أسلوب يمكنه معالجة البيانات المفقودة؟

questions.question: Which item can represent noisy data?
questions.question_ar: أي عنصر يمكن أن يمثل بيانات مشوشة؟

questions.question: Which action belongs to data preprocessing?
questions.question_ar: أي إجراء يندرج ضمن المعالجة المسبقة للبيانات؟

questions.question: What does oversampling do to minority-class examples?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يفعل Oversampling بأمثلة الفئة الأقلية؟
options: Increase the number of minority-class examples.
reduces the number of majority-class examples
synthetic examples for the majority class only
changes the target into a numerical feature
options_en: Increase the number of minority-class examples.
reduces the number of majority-class examples
synthetic examples for the majority class only
changes the target into a numerical feature
questions.explanation: Increase the number of minority-class examples.

questions.question: What does undersampling do to majority-class examples?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يفعل Undersampling بأمثلة الفئة الأكثرية؟
options: Reduce the number of majority-class examples.
synthetic examples for the majority class only
adds more branches to a decision tree
increases the number of minority-class examples
options_en: Reduce the number of majority-class examples.
synthetic examples for the majority class only
adds more branches to a decision tree
increases the number of minority-class examples
options_ar: يضيف فروعاً أكثر إلى شجرة القرار
questions.explanation: Reduce the number of majority-class examples.

questions.question: What does SMOTE create?
options: changes the target into a numerical feature
validation folds into one training record
reduces the number of majority-class examples
synthetic examples for the minority class
options_en: changes the target into a numerical feature
validation folds into one training record
reduces the number of majority-class examples
synthetic examples for the minority class
options_ar: طيات التحقق في سجل تدريب واحد
questions.explanation: SMOTE creates synthetic examples for the minority class.

questions.question: In five-fold cross-validation, into how many parts is the dataset divided?
questions.question_ar: في التحقق المتقاطع ذي الطيات الخمس، إلى كم جزء تقسم البيانات؟
questions.explanation: In five-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into five parts.

questions.question: What does an ensemble method combine?
options: Increase the number of minority-class examples.
increases the number of minority-class examples
synthetic examples for the majority class only
multiple models to produce a stronger prediction
options_en: Increase the number of minority-class examples.
increases the number of minority-class examples
synthetic examples for the majority class only
multiple models to produce a stronger prediction
questions.explanation: An ensemble method combines multiple models to produce a stronger prediction.
